svg.aria-label: One regulated level, drawn from the definition: the carried files and their gates, a person as their only writer, the loop's steps, the workload's unit types under their profiles, the router, the coordination mechanisms, the host checks, operational memory and the records the host writes

g.data-label: S5: the files the instance carries from the definition
g.data-def: identity: seeded from identity/ into regulator/identity/, accepted by `identity accept`, carried back by `identity promote`; advice: seeded from advice/ into regulator/advice/, accepted by `advice accept`, carried back by `advice promote`. Protected by Advice context, Advice decision path, Definition writers (the accept-path split), Identity context, Identity write gate, Instance manifest (regulator init), S5 decision path.
course-lab, alice may act as S5 under the interaction policy; the only writer of a carried file, through `identity accept` and `advice accept`. Rejecting changes nothing.

The authority check, then the write: `identity accept` and `advice accept` are the only writers of the instance's carried files (Advice decision path, Disposition authority, Prediction resolution, S5 decision path).

g.data-label: The router: a signal becomes an obligation
g.data-def: routing v1: 7 rule(s) saying what each message kind opens and for whom (algedonic-signal → human at blocking; policy-proposal → S5 at info; audit-finding → S3 at blocking; coordination-signal → S3 at advisory; operational-signal → S3 at blocking; uncertainty-signal → S3 at blocking; intelligence-signal → S3 at advisory); an open obligation at or above blocking vetoes the unit; 1 severity floor(s). Mechanism: Obligation router, Progression veto, Recovery router.

The orchestrator's steps, as ENFORCEMENT_POINTS.loop declares them, with the number of regulators that bite at each: runUnit (9), auditUnit (6), runHostChecks (4), routeUnit (4), closeUnit (4), driveUnit (1), routeAndDeliver (1), resolvePredictions (1), startUnit (0), finishUnit (4). The loop never edits code; it dispatches a session under a contract and a budget, verifies with host-run checks, routes by the recovery policy and closes on the ledger.
g.text: runUnit · auditUnit · runHostChecks · routeUnit · closeUnit · driveUnit · routeAndDeliver · resolvePredictions · startUnit · finishUnit

g.data-def: An open obligation at or above the routing policy's line, naming a unit, vetoes that unit's dispatch and close until a consumer dispositions it (Pause gate, Progression veto).

Read the repository and produce work contracts for S3 to dispatch. Never changes the repository. Runs under the `research` profile (7 tools, read-only by effect), without a contract; no host check. It touches the repository, so it is S1.

Change source and tests under a work contract, in an isolated worktree, and report the result. Runs under the `implement` profile (15 tools, writes under src/, test/), under a work contract; verified by run_checks, run_tests, inherited-tests, identity-untouched, export-signature, glossary-lint. It touches the repository, so it is S1.

Independently examine a unit's output against its contract and the project's invariants. Read-only. Runs under the `research` profile (7 tools, read-only by effect), under a work contract; verified by run_checks, run_tests, inherited-tests, identity-untouched, export-signature, glossary-lint. It touches the repository, so it is S1.

Reintegrate a unit's branch into the base and resolve what the harness refused to resolve on its own. Runs under the `implement` profile (15 tools, writes under src/, test/), under a work contract; verified by run_tests, inherited-tests, identity-untouched, export-signature, glossary-lint. It touches the repository, so it is S1.

Confirm evidence is fresh, obligations are dispositioned, and the unit may be retired. Read-only. Runs under the `research` profile (7 tools, read-only by effect), under a work contract; no host check. It touches the repository, so it is S1.

Answer one question about the environment — a dependency, a platform, an advisory, the project's own runtime behaviour — and report typed intelligence for S3. Read-only over the domain: its result is advice, never a commit and never a policy. Runs under the `intelligence` profile (10 tools, read-only by effect), under a work contract; no host check. It reports intelligence, so it is S4 at this level.

The loop's runUnit: a unit starts as an attempt under its profile's grant, its budget ceilings and a lease on its worktree. Regulators at runUnit: Budget guard, Command runner (a unit that runs a program), Obligation router, Pause gate, Post-merge check, Progression veto, Result report gate, Unit lifecycle, Work contract gate.
The typed tool research report(s) with; the signal lands in the regulatory log and goes to the router, never straight to a unit. Mechanism: Intelligence intake.

g.data-label: The router, at the units' level
g.data-def: Where a signal from a unit arrives: the routing policy routing opens an obligation for the consumer it names, or notes the message as trace.
An obligation opened on a unit is read back by the loop at its next step: the veto, the recovery decision, the person's answer.

Damping between units, as mechanism, with no coordinator persona: Effect journal (duplicated-effect); Reintegration guard (hidden-coupling); Thrash detector (oscillation); Unit lease gate (write-collision).
g.text: S2: effect journal · reintegration guard · thrash detector · unit lease gate

g.data-label: S3*: host checks at the revision
g.data-def: The host runs the checks itself at the unit's revision and the closeout gate reads that evidence, never the unit's claim. This workload names run_checks, run_tests, inherited-tests, identity-untouched, export-signature, glossary-lint. Regulators at runHostChecks and auditUnit: Behaviour check (export-signature), Glossary lint, Identity-untouched check (the instance's harness-owned files), Inherited tests check, Closeout gate, Instance manifest (regulator init).
g.text: S3* host checks at the revision → evidence → closeout gate

g.data-def: What S3* verifies is the unit's branch at the revision it reported, so the evidence is tied to a commit, not a transcript (Closeout gate).

facts a unit recorded with `remember`, each with provenance and an expiry; append-only, never identity; Give units one typed way to record what they learn about the environment — remember — into an append-only store separate from identity and from evidence.
The tool implement, integrate record(s) a fact with: provenance, scope and an expiry; a fact is never identity (Operational memory store).

`propose_policy_change` (implement, integrate, research; Proposal intake); `ask_human` (implement, integrate, research; Interaction contract (ask_human)): each opens an obligation owed to a person and changes nothing by itself.

13 paths under .regulator/, a closed list (INSTANCE_STORES): 10 records, 2 workspaces and the manifest. Written by the host from inside the loop and the session's gates, never by a unit directly; read by status, the control room, the eval harness and a person.

.regulator/instance.json: what `regulator init` wrote: the definition and its version, the Pi pin, the layout a person declared. Claimed by Doctor (the operating check), Instance manifest (regulator init).

.regulator/units/: one directory per unit: the unit record (the only mutable file), the contract, the report, one line per attempt and one per recovery decision. Claimed by Doctor (the operating check), Pause gate, Prediction resolution, Result report gate, Unit lifecycle, Work contract gate.
.regulator/leases/: one file per held lease on a worktree, with its owner and expiry. No registry record claims it as a resource.

.regulator/signals.ndjson: signals, the obligations they became, dispositions and prediction resolutions; append-only. Claimed by Algedonic delivery, Disposition authority, Intelligence intake, Interaction contract (ask_human), Obligation router, Pre-merge trial, Prediction resolution, Progression veto, Proposal intake.
.regulator/audit.ndjson: host-run evidence, technical verdicts and human acceptances, each bound to a revision; append-only. Claimed by Pre-merge trial, Prediction resolution.
.regulator/memory.ndjson: facts a unit recorded with `remember`, each with provenance and an expiry; append-only, never identity. Claimed by Identity context, Operational memory store.
.regulator/effects.ndjson: a side effect intended before it happens, committed after, reconciled on restart; append-only. Claimed by Algedonic delivery, Effect journal.
.regulator/trace.ndjson: the session's gated events as the extension records them. No registry record claims it as a resource.
.regulator/outbox: what is owed to a person, one delivery per line, forwarded by the watcher. Claimed by Algedonic delivery, Effect journal, Outbox watcher.
.regulator/outbox.cursor: how far the watcher has forwarded the outbox. Claimed by Outbox watcher.
.regulator/events.db: the SQLite regulatory event store. No registry record claims it as a resource.
.regulator/worktrees/: a unit's isolated checkout: domain output, not a record. No registry record claims it as a resource.
.regulator/trials/: the pre-merge trial's checkout of the merged tree, verified before a reintegration lands. Claimed by Pre-merge trial.
Every store is written by the host: the loop's steps and the session's gates append to the records, a unit writes only in its worktree. 19 records claim a store as a resource.
